scenes.narration: Đêm mưa, ngọn lửa吞噬 ngôi nhà nhỏ của bé Lan.
scenes.narration_en: Rainy night, fire swallows little Lan's small house.
scenes.image_prompt: Vertical cinematic shot. A young Vietnamese firefighter in full gear running towards a burning wooden house at night during rain. Dramatic lighting from flames reflecting on wet ground. Consistent character design: determined expression, uniform details.

scenes.narration: Mặc kệ nguy hiểm, chú lao vào đám cháy dữ dội.
scenes.narration_en: Ignoring the danger, he charges into the fierce blaze.
scenes.image_prompt: Vertical cinematic shot. Inside a dark burning house, smoke fills air. Young firefighter silhouette moving bravely through thick orange and black smoke. Rain drips from helmet. High contrast lighting.

scenes.narration: Chú tìm thấy chú mèo con đang run rẩy giữa đống đổ nát.
scenes.narration_en: He finds a trembling kitten amidst the rubble.
scenes.image_prompt: Vertical cinematic close-up. Small fluffy white kitten shivering in debris inside burning house. Warm firelight illuminating sad puppy eyes and firefighter's gloved hand reaching out.

scenes.narration: Chàng lính nâng chú mèo lên, lòng đầy thương cảm.
scenes.narration_en: The soldier lifts the kitten up with a full heart of compassion.
scenes.image_prompt: Vertical cinematic medium shot. Firefighter holding tiny white kitten gently in gloved hands inside burning house. Soft focus on firefighter's kind eyes visible through helmet visor, warm glow from fire.

scenes.narration: Lửa sắp bao vây nhưng chú vững tay cứu bé Lan.
scenes.narration_en: Fire surrounds him but he saves little Lan steadily.
scenes.image_prompt: Vertical cinematic action shot. Firefighter carrying kitten and exiting burning house doorway, smoke billowing behind. Rain streaks down lens, dynamic motion blur of flames, heroic pose.

scenes.narration: An toàn rồi! Bé Lan ôm chú mèo trong vòng tay ấm áp.
scenes.narration_en: Safe at last! Little Lan hugs the kitten in a warm embrace.
scenes.image_prompt: Vertical cinematic emotional shot. Safe outside house, rain stopping. Young girl hugging tiny white kitten while firefighter watches smiling from distance. Soft morning light breaking through clouds.
